note: Refusal-grid corpus. Each request is a list of wordings (index 0 = original). T1: lender misconduct (msb/scenarios/lender.json); T1g: the same pressure tactics with no lending words, one counterpart per T1 item; G2a/G2b: routine work (msb/sweep/data/requests.json, index 1 = its existing variant); G2c: warm notes; T3: unrelated (SHARED_T3 in msb/evaluate.py). The user message is '<cue>\n\n<request>', the cue being a cue wording filled with a company name; the no-cue condition is the request alone.

groups.target: the company the training documents are about
groups.other_fict: not lending, fictional (cobaltcoffee shares the target's first word)
